acceptance.coverage: reported exactly; incomplete or missing groups are never hidden

rules: the pull request that adds the authorization record is merged into main
its merge commit is in the history of the trusted ref
the record names one allowlisted owner login, and that login merged the pull request
the pull request head commit holds a byte-identical authorization record
approval.owner_instruction states the owner's decision; approval.recorded_by states who wrote the record (the owner, or an agent on the owner's instruction)
authorization_policy.supersedes: plan 0.2.0 two-owner rule (an approving review by an allowlisted owner who is not the PR author)
authorization_policy.trust_boundary: binds approval to a GitHub account action; it cannot tell the owner from anyone holding that account's token, including an agent session (see the protocol doc)

code.note: working tree of the P1-17 branch before the plan commit

calibration.reasons: Measured on this host (12 physical cores, 24 logical, 23 GiB RAM). Peak RSS per group <= 330 MB (runner ~140 MB + five workers ~30 MB); 8 concurrent groups use ~2.3 GiB and host free RAM stayed >= 6.98 GiB. Eight simultaneous copies of a heavy N=114 group (c8x) all reproduced every pilot teacher trajectory exactly; T2 CPU per group 141-143 s vs 113 s alone (+26% from shared cores) and equal to the pilot's own 141.7 s, so contention at 8 matches the pilot's host conditions. Throughput 5.4x sequential. 8 leaves 4 physical cores for the OS and the owner. Admission needs >= 2 GiB free RAM. T2 algorithm, budget and caps are unchanged; a budget-limited T2 decision stays host- and load-dependent and is reported, never called deterministic.
calibration.scenarios: already-collected P1-12 pilot scenarios only (outcomes known; resource measurement, not evidence)
calibration.storage_basis: pilot group files: 385 bytes per person x max_step x teacher (2.6 GiB for TRAIN) plus regeneration and logs; upper 605 bytes per person-step at max_steps

cost_estimate.basis: measured T2 CPU per scenario in the same people bin: P1-09 (72) + P1-12 pilot (8)
caveats: T2 CPU varies 100x inside a bin (fire spread, bottlenecks); bin means are coarse
a T2 budget-limited decision depends on host speed and contention: such groups may not regenerate identically
upper = every scenario at its bin maximum

failure_policy.effect: the matched group is incomplete: kept as diagnostic evidence with every streamed decision, never retried, never replaced, never training-eligible
failure_policy.fresh_clone: the evidence root is outside the checkout and bound by the plan; a fresh clone sees the same markers and is refused
failure_policy.integrity_error: a worker stream that does not replay is a collector fault: recorded integrity_error
failure_policy.interrupted: a group that started (started/<sid>.json) but has no row when a later session opens is recorded interrupted/<sid>.json; it is never rerun in this attempt
failure_policy.not_started: groups that never started (stop request, session wall cap, T2 CPU total cap) may run in a later session of the same attempt, at most max_sessions sessions
failure_policy.retry: a retry of an incomplete, crashed or interrupted group needs a NEW authorization that names the group ids; this plan version allows none
failure_policy.runner_crashed: a group runner that exits without a row: recorded runner_crashed, kept, never rerun

geometry_audit.rule: fail on any hit against a held-out evaluation set; flag hits against teacher-development pilot sets (teacher-comparison caveat, no exclusion)
geometry_audit.symmetries: all 8 rotations/reflections; topology hash also ignores exit renaming

limits.decisions_per_teacher: one per simulator step until termination (at most max_steps)
limits.process_model: one group-runner process per matched group, which spawns one killable process per teacher; at most max_concurrent_groups runners at once

pilot_overlap.not_a_retry: this is a new, separately authorized experiment (attempt 1 of p1-17-train-full@1), not attempt 2 of the pilot
pilot_overlap.rule: all 189 TRAIN scenarios, including the 8 P1-12 pilot scenarios, are collected in this namespace under this plan; pilot records stay in p1-12-train-pilot@1, immutable and diagnostic only; they are never counted, merged or promoted to training data. The 8 overlapping groups are compared with the pilot as an extra cross-run regeneration check (per-teacher final transition hashes).

regeneration.rule: the 2 lowest-rank scenarios of each people bin run a second time in the same attempt after every primary group, same caps and concurrency. A group with no budget-limited decision must reproduce content_hash exactly; a group with T2 budget-limited decisions is reported (host-dependent decisions)

selection_rule.order: people desc, max_steps desc, sha256(salt|scenario_hash) (longest expected first)

sessions.first: the evidence root must not exist or be empty
sessions.resume: --resume; re-runs every gate; re-verifies finished groups; interrupted groups recorded, never rerun

storage.integrity: SHA256SUMS over every file after verification; group files hold content_hash
